initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a provenance-ordering fault before Job 2. The top-level corpus and Job 2 input needs are in demand-descending order n06-r01 through n06-r08, but the handed-off evidence_sources ranks them as n06-r08, n06-r07, n06-r06, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r03, n06-r02, n06-r01. Job 2 then preserves that upstream provenance order when ranking unsupported needs, so the supported evidence localizes the order corruption to the upstream handoff rather than to Job 2. No exact function name is supplied in the visible evidence.
